item.title: Pages - Action recommended - Node.js 18 end-of-life and impact on Pages Build System V2
item.description:
• If you are using Pages Build System V2 for a Git-connected Pages project, note that the default Node.js version, Node.js 18, will end its LTS support on April 30, 2025.
  • Pages will not change the default Node.js version in the Build System V2 at this time, instead, we strongly recommend pinning a modern Node.js version to ensure your builds are consistent and secure.
  • You can pin any Node.js version by:
    1. Adding a NODE_VERSION environment variable with the desired version specified as the value.
    2. Adding a .node-version file with the desired version specified in the file.
  • Pinning helps avoid unexpected behavior and ensures your builds stay up-to-date with your chosen runtime. We also recommend pinning all critical tools and languages that your project relies on.

item.title: Pages - Support for pnpm 10 in build system
item.description: • Pages build system now supports building projects that use pnpm 10 as the package manager. If your build previously failed due to this unsupported version, retry your build. No config changes needed.

item.title: Pages - Cloudflare GitHub App Permissions Update
item.description:
• Cloudflare is requesting updated permissions for the Cloudflare GitHub App to enable features like automatically creating a repository on your GitHub account and deploying the new repository for you when getting started with a template. This feature is coming out soon to support a better onboarding experience.
    • Requested permissions:
      • Repository Administration (read/write) to create repositories.
      • Contents (read/write) to push code to the created repositories.
    • Who is impacted:
      • Existing users will be prompted to update permissions when GitHub sends an email with subject "[GitHub] Cloudflare Workers & Pages is requesting updated permission" on December 19th, 2024.
      • New users installing the app will see the updated permissions during the connecting repository process.
    • Action: Review and accept the permissions update to use upcoming features. If you decline or take no action, you can continue connecting repositories and deploying changes via the Cloudflare GitHub App as you do today, but new features requiring these permissions will not be available.
    • Questions? Visit #github-permissions-update in the Cloudflare Developers Discord.

item.title: Pages - Updating Bun version to 1.1.33 in V2 build system
item.description:
• Bun version is being updated from 1.0.1 to 1.1.33 in Pages V2 build system. This is a minor version change, please see details at Bun.
  • If you wish to use a previous Bun version, you can override default version.

item.title: Pages - Support for D1's new storage subsystem and build error message improvements
item.description:
• Added support for D1's new storage subsystem. All Git builds and deployments done with Wrangler v3.5.0 and up can use the new subsystem.
  • Builds which fail due to exceeding the build time limit will return a proper error message indicating so rather than Internal error.
  • New and improved error messages for other build failures

item.title: Pages - Commit message limit increase
item.description: • Commit messages can now be up to 384 characters before being trimmed.

item.title: Pages - Support for newer TLDs
item.description: • Support newer TLDs such as .party and .music.

item.title: Pages - V2 build system enabled by default
item.description: • V2 build system is now default for all new projects.

item.title: Pages - Sped up project creation
item.description: • Sped up project creation.

item.title: Pages - Build error message improvement
item.description: • Builds which fail due to Out of memory (OOM) will return a proper error message indicating so rather than Internal error.

item.title: Pages - V2 build system beta
item.description: • The V2 build system is now available in open beta. Enable the V2 build system by going to your Pages project in the Cloudflare dashboard and selecting Settings > Build & deployments > Build system version.

item.title: Pages - Support for Smart Placement
item.description: • Smart placement can now be enabled for Pages within your Pages Project by going to Settings > Functions.

item.title: Pages - Git projects can now see files uploaded
item.description: • Files uploaded are now visible for Git projects, you can view them in the Cloudflare dashboard.

item.title: Pages - Notifications for Pages are now available
item.description:
• Notifications for Pages events are now available in the Cloudflare dashboard. Events supported include:
    • Deployment started.
    • Deployment succeeded.
    • Deployment failed.

item.title: Pages - Analytics Engine now available in Functions
item.description: • Added support for Analytics Engine in Functions.

item.title: Pages - Queues now available in Functions
item.description: • Added support for Queues producer in Functions.

item.title: Pages - API messaging update
item.description: Updated all API messaging to be more helpful.

item.title: Pages - Ability to delete aliased deployments
item.description: • Aliased deployments can now be deleted. If using the API, you will need to add the query parameter force=true.

item.title: Pages - Deep linking to a Pages deployment
item.description: • You can now deep-link to a Pages deployment in the dashboard with :pages-deployment. An example would be https://dash.cloudflare.com?to=/:account/pages/view/:pages-project/:pages-deployment.

item.title: Pages - Functions GA and other updates
item.description:
• Pages functions are now GA. For more information, refer to the blog post.
  • We also made the following updates to Functions:
    • Functions metrics are now available in the dashboard.
    • Functions billing is now available.
    • The Unbound usage model is now available for Functions.
    • Secrets are now available.
    • Functions tailing is now available via the dashboard or with Wrangler (wrangler pages deployment tail).

item.title: Pages - Service bindings now available in Functions
item.description: • Service bindings are now available in Functions. For more details, refer to the docs.

item.title: Pages - Ansi color codes in build logs
item.description: Build log now supports ansi color codes.

item.title: Pages - Deep linking to a Pages project
item.description: • You can now deep-link to a Pages project in the dashboard with :pages-project. An example would be https://dash.cloudflare.com?to=/:account/pages/view/:pages-project.

item.title: Pages - Increased domain limits
item.description:
Previously, all plans had a maximum of 10 custom domains per project.

Now, the limits are:

  • Free: 100 custom domains.
  • Pro: 250 custom domains.
  • Business and Enterprise: 500 custom domains.

item.title: Pages - Support for _routes.json
item.description: • Pages now offers support for _routes.json. For more details, refer to the documentation.

item.title: Pages - Increased build log expiration time
item.description: Build log expiration time increased from 2 weeks to 1 year.

item.title: Pages - New bindings supported
item.description: • R2 and D1 bindings are now supported.

item.title: Pages - Added support for .dev.vars in wrangler pages
item.description:
Pages now supports .dev.vars in wrangler pages, which allows you to use use environmental variables during your local development without chaining --envs.

This functionality requires Wrangler v2.0.16 or higher.

item.title: Pages - Added deltas to wrangler pages publish
item.description:
Pages has added deltas to wrangler pages publish.

We now keep track of the files that make up each deployment and intelligently only upload the files that we have not seen. This means that similar subsequent deployments should only need to upload a minority of files and this will hopefully make uploads even faster.

This functionality requires Wrangler v2.0.11 or higher.

item.title: Pages - Added branch alias to PR comments
item.description: • PR comments for Pages previews now include the branch alias.
